summary: Online research reinforced two implementation changes: bind Hugging Face cache/offline env before imports via a common sourced script, and keep snapshot download planning/materialization separate from local-only Transformers capture.

sources.use: Hub environment variables are read at import time; HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE/HF_XET_CACHE/HF_ASSETS_CACHE define cache locations.
Hub dry-run and snapshot download planning can estimate/cache required files before materialization.
Transformers offline mode requires files to be downloaded/cached ahead of time; local_files_only can load from local directory.
TinyLlama model card supports the 1.1B Llama-family public trace target and Transformers usage.
TinyLlama paper describes the compact 1.1B open-source model project.

implementation_decisions: source one common env script in all active public-trace wrappers
make smoke_validate hard-gate current run packet/source lock identity
teach closure audits to follow source/. shell references so common env is carried into external runner packets
